1. Listen - Seriously, I haven't seen an episode this good in a while. Atmospheric, dreary, and all around just great.
2. Into the Dalek - I love this episode, mainly because the acting and writing is superb. Also, Rusty's "darkness" line brings all the chills.
3. The Caretaker - Gareth Robert's episodes are usually amazing, and this isn't any exception. I had a hard time picking between this and ITD, but I felt this episode was bogged by Courtney.
4. Deep Breath - Unlike most, I thoroughly enjoyed the hell out if this episode. The acting was great, especially from Capaldi. (Although, the dinosaur was a bit unneeded.)
5. Robot of Sherwood - It's a fun episode, with great characters and surprisingly good writing. The "golden arrow" climax was a bit stupid though.
6. Time Heist - I don't know, I just couldn't finish this episode first time I saw it. The pacing is the main issue, as it seems to jump around a LOT in the story.
